messages:
harper: Quick non-work poll 60a Looking for a 20min TV episode to watch at lunch + a 3-song commute playlist to jump back into afternoon focus. drop combos or vote with emoji.
kevin: Love a tiny sitcom ep. 'The Office' S2 ep1 is perfect for a quick laugh. Playlist: 3 upbeat indie tracks to reset.
li: For something calmer: a single Black Mirror short ep (or the 20-min shorts) + mellow instrumental trio (piano, soft synth, light percussion).
jas: Action pick: one eps of 'Fleabag' (emotional comedy) actually, it's perfect for a bite break + three songs: one banger, one chill, one weird.
harper: vote emoji: 
  :one: = Office + indie trio
  :two: = Black Mirror + instrumental trio
  :three: = Fleabag + banger/chill/weird
commute-bot: auto-playlist links: https://open.spotify.fake/office-indie (3 tracks), https://open.spotify.fake/blackmirror-instrumental (3 tracks), https://open.spotify.fake/fleabag-mix (3 tracks)
kevin: :one: from me. quick laugh reboots my patience for meetings.
li: :two: from me. helps me not doom-scroll after lunch.
jas: :three: from me. variety keeps lunchtime interesting.
harper: tally: 1,1,1. tie! tiebreaker: name a single must-have track from your mini-playlist.
kevin: "Shimmer Street" (indie upbeat, 3:10)
li: "Quiet Window" (minimal piano loop, 4:05)
jas: "Crash-and-Echo" (weird synth bridge, 2:48)
harper: OK rotating plan: I'll run a tiny shared queue in the kitchen jukebox today 12:30-13:10: each pick gets 10min. also I'll drop the episode links in #random-quiet-tv. Come by if you want to watch and eat at the bigger table.
kevin: bringing leftover pad thai. not sharing the peanuts. :grimacing:
li: bringing tea and a small fold-up blanket for dramatic posture.
jas: I'll drop my Fleabag episode link in thread and bring extra earbuds.
commute-bot: reminder posted for lunchtime queue 12:30 (auto-message).
